quotations.old_english: Secgas, mid sigecwén, aseten hæfdon, on Créca land
quotations.english: the men had a dwelling together with the victorious queen, in the land of the Greeks

source_text: a-sittan; p. -sæt, pl. -sǽton; pp. -seten To dwell together; consi&dash-uncertain;dere :-- Secgas, mid sigecwén, aseten hæfdon, on Créca land the men had a dwelling together with the victorious queen, in the land of the Greeks, Elen. Kmbl. 1993; El. 998. v. sittan II.
